title: Mising visibility paramater in CresteSessionRequest
description: Mobile team currently sends two requests to when creating new Sessions. One to create and other to update visibility. We MUST give them option to send visibility in one request and do it in one request. Check if same must be done for update session
close_reason: Added visibility to CreateSessionRequest/UpdateSessionRequest (now required on both), wired through to domain SetVisibility/NewSession, and removed the standalone-must-be-public restriction so standalone sessions can be public or private.

title: Private standalone sessions have no invite/attendee-add mechanism
description: A private standalone session (no activity_group_id) can now be created/updated as private (see rekreativko-api-h9r), but there's no way for anyone other than the creator to become an attendee. CreateRSVP rejects self-RSVP for a private session unless the requester is a confirmed group member or the session is public; a standalone session has no group at all, so only the creator (auto-attendee on creation) can ever attend. GroupInvite/SendInvite only works against activity_group_id, so it can't be used for a standalone session either. Need a session-level invite or direct attendee-add mechanism (e.g. creator invites specific users to a private standalone session) so private standalone sessions are actually usable beyond a party of one.
